def dfs(node, parent, low, disc, time, graph, critical_links):
    time += 1
    disc[node] = low[node] = time
    children = 0
    
    for neighbor in graph[node]:
        if disc[neighbor] == 0:
            children += 1
            dfs(neighbor, node, low, disc, time, graph, critical_links)
            low[node] = min(low[node], low[neighbor])
            
            if parent != -1 and low[neighbor] > disc[node]:
                if abs(disc[node] - disc[neighbor]) < P:
                    critical_links.add((min(node, neighbor), max(node, neighbor)))
        
        elif neighbor != parent:
            low[node] = min(low[node], disc[neighbor])
    
    return children

def find_critical_links(N, M, P, edges):
    graph = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for A, B in edges:
        graph[A].append(B)
        graph[B].append(A)
